title: Govern one agent session through an admitted hook interlock
audience: Engineers, operators, architects, and product owners building dependable agentic systems.
humanProblem: The agent can publish a capability change, but its assignment authorizes only inspection.

experience.input: Publication is queued beyond an inspection-only assignment.
experience.event: The target interlock resolves authority, keeps publication pending, and permits the exact inspection.
experience.outcome: The engineer receives an inspection report and retains the separate publication decision.

entities.outcome: Reviews the requested inspection with control intact

entities.event: Identity, authority, coverage, proof and requested mechanic checked
entities.outcome: Decision tied to intended effect evidence

mechanics.meaning: Exact stored adjudication expression selects ALLOW or OPERATOR_REQUIRED.
Proposed pre-dispatch resolution and effect linkage complete the intended experience.

claims.text: The inspected capsule contains decision expressions and declared status assertions; these do not establish observed live interception.
The intended interlock resolves exact authority before effects, permits admitted work and retains operator control.
Seven reference cases evaluate an authored target policy; they dispatch no live tools.
The fictional engineer receives the intended inspection while publication remains pending.

scope: Current snapshot evidence, an explicitly labeled target architecture, and fictional human staging. Reference simulation is not live hook execution. The target decision vocabulary is not relabeled as current capsule output.
storyTitle: When the Agent Is Ready to Act, Who Decides?

training.objective: Distinguish present decision semantics from the intended live enforcement boundary and its closure evidence.
training.exercise: Resolve an out-of-scope publication to a permitted inspection, then identify the live evidence needed to establish the target boundary.

questions.question: The agent is authorized to inspect a candidate but queues publication. What is the target response?
options: Publish because the tool is available.
RESOLVE to the authorized inspection; keep publication pending.
Let the agent expand its own scope.
questions.rationale: RESOLVE offers a permitted next step without approving the original effect.

questions.question: What does the current stored ALLOW expression establish?
options: The stored expression defines how a supplied input maps to a decision.
A live hook has been certified.
questions.rationale: Current decision semantics do not supply live effect-enforcement evidence.

questions.question: Which evidence would close the intended live-boundary claim?
options: One identity-bound live session denies an unmanaged probe and permits a declared read-only probe, with coverage and effect receipts.
questions.rationale: Both observations must refer to the same exact live boundary.

questions.question: After a permitted inspection, is publication authorized?
options: No. Publication still needs its own authority and proof.
Yes. A successful inspection authorizes later effects.
questions.rationale: The inspection outcome never widens the agent's authority.
